Name: Server IPv4 Port
Description: Port for game traffic. NetherNet uses it for the TCP signaling handshake, RakNet for UDP gameplay

Name: Server IPv6 Port
Description: Port for IPv6 game traffic. RakNet only - NetherNet ignores it and opens a dual-stack socket on the IPv4 port instead

Name: NetherNet UDP Transport Ports
Description: UDP port pool NetherNet allocates client connections from. Only bound while clients are connected, and ignored when Transport is RakNet
